parts.text: Some IGCSE students have been asked to investigate how different surfaces absorb thermal radiation. The apparatus is set up as shown in Fig. 2.1, with a piece of white card in close contact with the thermometer bulb. The distance between the card and the lamp is 1.0 cm.
